class.name: OriginRebasing
class.brief_description: Floating-origin helper that shifts the world back by multiples of a grid step when the camera drifts too far.
class.description: When the camera is further than [member threshold] from the engine origin, [method check] returns a shift (a multiple of [member grid_step]) and [method apply] moves every top-level [Node3D] by it. The accumulated origin is stored as exact integer cells so no precision is lost however many shifts happen. Because shifts are grid multiples, world-space noise stays seamless when sampled at [code]world_pos + noise_offset(period)[/code] with [code]period[/code] dividing [member grid_step].

method.name: get_shift_count
method.description: Returns how many shifts have been committed.

method.name: check
method.description: Returns the shift to apply, or [constant Vector3.ZERO] while the camera is within [member threshold].

method.name: apply
method.description: Moves every top-level [Node3D] child of [param root] that is not in the [code]origin_rebase_exclude[/code] group by [param shift], commits the shift and notifies listeners. Returns the number of moved nodes.

method.name: commit
method.description: Accounts for a shift that the caller already applied (for example to physics bodies) and notifies listeners.

method.name: add_listener
method.description: Registers a callback [code]func(shift: Vector3)[/code] for systems that cache world positions.

method.name: remove_listener
method.description: Unregisters a listener added with [method add_listener].

method.name: to_global_world
method.description: Converts an engine-local position to a logical world position.

method.name: to_local_world
method.description: Converts a logical world position to an engine-local position.

method.name: to_global_split
method.description: Returns a drift-free representation [code]{"cell": Vector3i, "rem": Vector3}[/code] of a local position, with world position equal to [code]cell * grid_step + rem[/code] and [code]rem[/code] in [code][0, grid_step)[/code].

method.name: from_global_split
method.description: Inverse of [method to_global_split], relative to the current origin.

method.name: noise_offset
method.description: Returns the offset to add to engine-local positions before sampling world-space noise of the given [param period].

method.name: get_exclude_group
method.description: Returns the group name ([code]origin_rebase_exclude[/code]) that excludes a node from [method apply].

members.member: Distance of the camera from the engine origin that triggers a rebase.
All shifts are multiples of this value.
If [code]true[/code], the Y axis is ignored when deciding and shifting.
World position of the engine origin, in [member grid_step] cells.
